audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications on Windows, Linux, or macOS who need spreadsheet functionality without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format using Workbook.Save().
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Set cell values with PutValue() accepting strings, integers, doubles, bools, and DateTime; retrieve values via GetValue(); and manage formulas with SetFormula() and GetFormula().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify cell appearance using Style objects that bundle Font (bold, color), FillPattern, foreground/background colors, Borders, alignment, and text wrap.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styles and formatting

capabilities.text: Control worksheet visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, and apply protection via Worksheet properties and WorksheetProtection.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet structure and protection

capabilities.text: Define rule-driven formatting with ConditionalFormattingCollection and ValidationCollection for input constraints, both scoped to CellArea ranges.
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting and data validation

capabilities.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, scaling, print area/titles, headers/footers, and page breaks via PageSetup on each worksheet.
capabilities.title: Configure page setup and print options

capabilities.text: Attach hyperlinks to cell ranges using HyperlinkCollection and manage workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges via DefinedNameCollection.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and defined names

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended metadata through WorkbookProperties and DocumentProperties exposed on Workbook.
capabilities.title: Access document properties

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for load and save; saving to any other format throws UnsupportedFeatureException.
Legacy SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) is not implemented; mapper classes for it unconditionally throw UnsupportedFeatureException.
Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName has a Comment field for named ranges.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are dropped with a WarningInfo during load rather than preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load rather than approximated.
Prebuilt binaries are available only for Windows using MSVC v14x toolset; other platforms require building from source.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and manipulation in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or proprietary dependencies.
Provides a familiar API surface compatible with Aspose.Cells commercial products for teams migrating from or extending existing workflows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, header-and-source C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports loading or saving .xlsb or .ods formats beyond .xlsx is not confirmed by the facts.
The exact set of conditional formatting rule types that are dropped with WarningInfo during load is not specified beyond 'some advanced' types.
Whether AutoFilter date-group filters using specific unsupported patterns are documented elsewhere is not evident from the facts.
The behavior of Workbook constructors when loading malformed or corrupted .xlsx files beyond InvalidFileFormatException is not detailed.
Whether the library supports reading or writing CSV, PDF, or other non-OOXML formats is not supported by the facts.
The scope of supported formula functions in SetFormula() is not detailed beyond basic formula text handling.

workflows.name: Create and style a workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access its first Worksheet, populate cells with values and formulas, apply header styling using Style and Font objects, and save the result as an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Load and read an existing workbook
workflows.text: Construct a Workbook from a file path or in-memory std::vector<std::uint8_t> stream, then read cell values, formulas, and metadata.

workflows.name: Apply conditional formatting and validation
workflows.text: Add conditional formatting rules via ConditionalFormattingCollection and FormatCondition, and define data validation constraints using ValidationCollection and Validation scoped to CellArea ranges.

workflows.name: Configure print and view settings
workflows.text: Set worksheet visibility, zoom, gridline and header visibility, right-to-left layout, and page setup options including paper size, orientation, margins, and print area via Worksheet and PageSetup objects.
